sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** "AYUSHMAN BHARAT PM-JAY MUKH MANTRI SEHAT BIMA YOJNA” is a flagship State Health Insurance Program of the Government of Punjab.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Health & Wellness; Sector: Health Insurance

**Detailed Description:** Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Mukhmantri Sehat Bima Yojana (AB PM-JAY MMSBY), was launched on 20 August 2019 this is a flagship State Health Insurance Scheme for the beneficiaires of State of Punjab. AB PM-JAY MMSBY will provide financial protection to 65% population of state of Punjab. It is entitlement based cashless Health Insurance cover. Under this scheme cashless and paperless treatment is available at Government and empaneled Private hospitals. <br>

**Benefits / Assistance:** - A cashless health insurance cover of ₹5,00,000/- rupees per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization (in-patient services) for treatment of listed diseases and medical conditions.

**Application Process:** > **REGISTRATION PROCESS FOR E-CARD GENERATION** - Now generate e-card from home without visiting anywhere: Download 'Ayushman App' on mobile or visit [https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/](https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/) to self-register.- Please visit any empaneled private or public hospital, lists available under '[Hospitals](https://sha.punjab.gov.in/shapb/publicPages/hospSpltyView)' on SHA website for getting e-card generation.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Department of Health & Family Welfare
